name: libmicrodns
primary_metric: Debian popcon sourcemax installations (max over binary packages built from the source package)
reason: mDNS client/announcer library. Its installed header microdns.h exports only mdns_init, mdns_destroy, mdns_entries_send, mdns_entries_print, mdns_strerror, mdns_listen, mdns_announce, mdns_serve and mdns_request_initial_announce; message parsing is internal to the socket loop, with no documented API for caller-supplied message bytes.

name: dnsjit
primary_metric: Debian popcon sourcemax installations (max over binary packages built from the source package)
input_api_lead: Lua core.object.dns (parse) inside the dnsjit engine
reason: Not attempted this round. dnsjit is a LuaJIT engine program: Debian builds dnsjit and an Architecture: all dnsjit-dev that installs only usr/include and man3 pages, so there is no linkable C library; the documented parser is the Lua core.object.dns module, which a harness would have to drive through the dnsjit executable and a Lua script.
